text: Being good to parents is the greatest [and most important] duty.
Be good to your parents and your children will be good to you.
Whoever is good to his parents, his child will be good to him.
The death of a father breaks one’s back.
One who scorns his parents has diverged from the right path.
The affection of parents is [the basis of] the relationship between siblings.
Seek goodness in the hoofs of the camel when driven away and when coming back.

topic: The Son of Adam (The Human Being)
text: How wretched the son of Adam is! His death is hidden, his ailments concealed, his every action recorded, harmed by the bite of a mosquito, made malodorous by perspiration and caused to die by [something as simple as] choking.

topic: The Son of Adam (The Human Being)
text: Woe to the son of Adam! How heedless and negligent of his salvation he is!

topic: The Son of Adam (The Human Being)
text: Woe to the son of Adam! A prisoner of hunger, prone to overeating, a target of calamities and a successor of the dead. Grandeur .
flag_note: The text ends abruptly with a stray word 'Grandeur .' that does not form a complete sentence.

text: Self-sacrifice is a virtue, hoarding [wealth] is a vice.
Self-sacrifice is the noblest benevolence.
Self-sacrifice is a trait of the virtuous.
Self-sacrifice is the highest degree of benevolence.
Self-sacrifice is the noblest munificence.
Self-sacrifice is the highest form of benevolence.
Self-sacrifice is the loftiest of noble traits.
Self-sacrifice is the greatest worship and the most sublime eminence.
Self-sacrifice is the highest level of munificence and the most excellent quality.
Self-sacrifice is the best [form of] benevolence and the highest stage of faith.
Self-sacrifice is a trait of the virtuous and a quality of the righteous.
The most excellent generosity is self-sacrifice.
The greatest munificence is self-sacrifice.
It is through self-sacrifice that the free become enslaved.1
flag_note: Contains a stray numeric character at the end of the sentence.

text: It is through self-sacrifice that munificence gets true meaning.
By preferring others over yourself, you gain [their] servitude.
The best of noble traits is self-sacrifice.
It is when they prefer others over themselves that the spirit of noble people becomes evident.
The highest of noble traits is self-sacrifice.
Self-sacrifice suffices as nobility.
Whoever prefers others to himself has reached the height of magnanimity.
Whoever prefers others to himself deserves to be called a person of virtue.
One who prefers you to his property and wealth has preferred you over himself.
From the qualities of the virtuous is impelling themselves to be selfless.
One of best [form of] benevolence is self-sacrifice.
One of the most excellent choices is adorning oneself with selflessness.
Nobility cannot be fully achieved but by self-restraint and self-sacrifice.

The appointed time of death is [already] determined and sustenance is [already] apportioned, so let not any of you grieve its reduction; for verily greed does not expedite it and self-restraint does not delay it, and it behoves a believer to be patient.
The truest thing is death.
The nearest thing is death.
The reality of death exposes the lie of [false] aspiration.
At every moment there is death.
The remembrance of [the times of] death has disappeared from your hearts and has been replaced by false hopes and aspirations.
Your hearts have forgotten the reality of death and you have been overcome by deception of [false] hope.
The one who takes death into consideration values his time.
One whose death draws near to him cannot be saved [from it] by his efforts.
The passing of time draws one towards death.
How is it possible for one to live forever, when there will come a day which he will not pass and a seeker who will quickly bring him to his death, urging him forwards?
It is when [the time of] death comes that the failure of [one’s] aspirations become apparent.
When death strikes, hopes and aspirations are exposed.
Every future [event] is near.
How many a person has delayed his work until death came upon him!
The appointed time of death is sufficient as a guard.
There is a prescribed duration for every term [of life].
Death strikes down.
Departure [from this world] is imminent.
The appointed time of death is a shield.
The appointed time of death is an impenetrable fortress.
Death cuts hopes short.
Death exposes hope.
Death is the reaper of hope.
When death comes, hopes are exposed.
When you reach the end of your hopes, then remember the suddenness of death.
The bane of aspirations is the coming of death.
The bane of hope is death.
Your death will [soon] come to you, so be moderate in what you seek.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: Anticipate death, for verily the hopes of people are on the verge of being cut short as death comes upon them.
Anticipate death and do good deeds; [by this] you will attain felicity through your [hastening to good deeds while you have] respite.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: Every moment you come closer to death, so improve your deeds.
For every appointed time there is an arrival.
For every person there is a day that he shall not go beyond.
For everyone there is a driver who drives him towards his death.
If the appointed times of death were to become known, the [secret] hopes [of people] would be exposed.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: If you were to see death and its approach, you would surely hate [false] aspiration and its deception.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: If you were to think about the closeness of death and its [imminent] arrival, the sweetness of life and its comfort would become bitter for you.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: Whoever is mindful of his [eventual] death reduces his aspirations.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: Whoever regards his stay [in this world] as short and temporary, his hope and aspiration gets diminished.
One who rides with the reins of his aspiration stumbles over his death.
How close hope is to death!
How severing death is for hope!
He who counts tomorrow [to be] from his lifetime has not given death its rightful place.
What an excellent cure death is!
Each breath of a person is a step closer to his death.
No shield is more protective than the appointed time of death.
Nothing is truer than death.
You are the harvests of the appointed terms and the targets of death.
May the mercy of Allah be on the person who understands that his [every] breath brings him a step closer to his death, so he hastens to [do] good deeds and shortens his hopes.
May the mercy of Allah be on the person who anticipates [his] death, belies [his false] aspirations, and makes his actions sincere.
Sometimes death is [hidden] beneath an aspiration.
With the passing of hours, lifetimes perish.

Verily there is a shield over me, in the form of my appointed time of death, which protects me; so when my day comes, it relieves itself of me and surrenders me [to death]. At this time the arrow will not miss its target and the wound will not heal.
The Hereafter is the victory of the felicitous.
Occupying yourself with improving your Hereafter will save you from the chastisement of hellfire.
The [true] winner is one who has sold this transitory life for the [eternal] Hereafter.
Wealth and children are the adornment of the life of this world whereas good deeds are the tillage of the Hereafter.
The conditions in this world are based on convention whereas the conditions in the Hereafter are based on merit.

Surely in front of you is a difficult place of ascension in which one whose weight is lighter is in a better position than the one whose weight is heavier, and the one who moves slowly is worse off than the one who moves swiftly. Verily its landing will lead you to either Paradise or hell.

Verily the final destination is al-Qiyāmah and this is enough of an admonition for the one who reasons, and [enough of] a warning for the one who is unaware; and after that - what you know of the torment of the Day of Judgment and the frightening terror, and the deafening of the ears, and the turning of the ribs, and the narrowness of the grave, and the intensity of sadness and heavy-heartedness.
If you desire success and honor in the Hereafter, then take from the perishing [life of this world] for the everlasting [life of the Hereafter].
Verily you are following the path of those who came before you, so put your efforts in [working for] your Hereafter and do not care for worldly gain.
Verily you have been created for the Hereafter, so work for it!
If you work for the Hereafter, your arrow hits the mark.
Verily you are all proceeding towards the Hereafter and will be presented before Allah.
The sweetness of the Hereafter removes the pangs of misery of this world.
Attain the Hereafter by abandoning this world, and don’t [try to] acquire [the embellishments of] this world by abandoning the faith.
flag_note: Contains bracketed editorial insertions that disrupt the original text flow.

text: The Hereafter is everlasting.
Blessed is he who remembers the Hereafter and thus does good.
The seeker of the Hereafter finds in it what he hopes for, whereas in this world [only] that which is predestined for him comes to him.
flag_note: Contains bracketed editorial insertions that disrupt the original text flow.

text: You must strive and struggle for the betterment of the Hereafter.
I wonder at the one who denies the second genesis while he sees the first genesis.
The goal of the Hereafter is everlasting [life].
flag_note: Contains bracketed editorial insertions that disrupt the original text flow.

text: In the Hereafter there is accounting without action.
Be from the children of the Hereafter and do not be from the children of this world, for surely every child will join his mother on the Day of Reckoning.
One who works for the Hereafter will be triumphant.
One who develops his Hereafter achieves his aspirations.
One who buys his Hereafter with his worldly life, gains both of them.
One who builds the abode of his permanent dwelling is truly wise.
One who is certain about the Hereafter turns away from this world.
One who improves his Hereafter will be triumphant.
One who is certain about the Hereafter does not covet this world.
One who is desirous of the Hereafter [and works for it] attains it.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: Everything in the Hereafter has perpetuity and everlastingness.
There is no substitute for the Hereafter; and this world is not the price of one’s soul.
He who does not concern himself with improving his Hereafter is not a [true] believer.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: One who longs for the bounties of the Hereafter is content with little in this world.
Who is more at a loss than the one who trades his Hereafter for this world?!
One who puts all his efforts for [the betterment of] his Hereafter succeeds in attaining what he looks forward to.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: Whoever strives for his permanent abode, his action becomes sincere and his fear [of displeasing Allah] increases.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: One who is certain about his Hereafter thinks no more of this world.
Whoever increases his remembrance of the Hereafter, his transgression reduces.
One who strives to improve his Hereafter, Allah will improve for him his worldly life.
One whose efforts are for the Hereafter will attain the best of his aspired goals.
One who does not work for the Hereafter will not attain what he hopes for.

One who has three [qualities] will have saved his life in this world and the Hereafter: he commands good and himself follows it, forbids evil and himself keeps away from it, and is careful in following the commandments of Allah, the Mighty and High.
How great a loser is the one for whom there is no share in the Hereafter!
The bitterness of this world is the sweetness of the Hereafter.

The deceived one who succeeds in attaining the smallest portion of this world [through his greatest effort] is not comparable the one who succeeds in attaining [the smallest portion of] the Hereafter by exerting his greatest effort.
flag_note: contains bracketed editorial insertions

text: He who works for his Eternal Abode obtains what he desires.
Do not sell the Hereafter for this world and do not exchange the everlasting for the evanescent.
Never let anything occupy you from working for the Hereafter for indeed the time is short.
The Hereafter and this world do not come together.
The perishing and the permanent do not go together.
No one attains what he wishes for in the Hereafter except by abstaining from that which he desires in this world.
It behoves one who is certain about the everlastingness and permanence of the Hereafter to work for it.
People do not abstain from anything of their worldly life for the sake of improving their Hereafter but that Allah, the Glorified, recompenses them with what is better than it.
Aspire for what Allah has promised the God-wary, for surely the truest promises are His promises.
Verily tomorrow is close to today. This day will pass with what is in it and tomorrow will come [soon] following it.
The [final] destination is in front of you and time is behind you, pushing you [forward].
Verily you have an ultimate destination so move towards your destination, and you have a guide so move towards it with [the help of] your guide.

A man may be happy to gain what he was not meant to lose, and [he may be] saddened to lose what he was not meant to gain; so let your happiness be in that which you have acquired for your Hereafter and let your sadness be in that which you have lost from it; and let your concern be for that which comes after death.

Let your concern be for your Hereafter and your sorrow be for your soul - for how many of the sorrowful have been led to everlasting bliss by their sorrow, and how many of the distressed have attained their aspiration.
Prepare yourselves for the day when the eyes will be glazed, and the minds will lose their sanity because of its horror, and the perceptions will become dull.
Beware of the day when the deeds are audited, when earthquakes increase and when young children turn old.

Be careful not to be swindled out of the Permanent Abode, the dwelling of the righteous and the virtuous elite, about whose qualities the Qur’an has spoken and whose dwellers it has praised; while Allah, the Glorified, has guided you and invited you to it.
Is there nobody who has prepared the provisions for his Hereafter before the coming of [the hour of] his departure?
The Hereafter is the abode of your permanent stay, so prepare for it that which will be lasting for you.
Place your concern and effort for your Hereafter.
Be concerned about your Hereafter and you will become upright.
Exert all your effort for your afterlife and your [final] station will be improved, and do not sell your Hereafter for your worldly life.
Work hard in preparing the answers for the Day of Questioning and Reckoning.
Those who have the greatest share of the Hereafter are those who have the smallest share of this world.

I enjoin you to be well prepared and increase your provisions for the day when you will meet with what you have sent forth and regret what you have left behind, and will be rewarded for what you had forwarded [in advance].

When you turn away from the transitory world and become occupied with the permanent abode, then your arrow has indeed hit its mark, the doors of prosperity are opened for you and you have attained success.
The reward of the Hereafter makes one forget the hardships of this world.
Take from what will not last for you and what you will not last for [of this world] for that which you will not separate from and which will not separate from you [of the Hereafter].
Partake in the best of actions and befriend the best of friends; for verily every person will get that which he has earned and will be with the one whom he loves in the Hereafter.
The Everlasting Abode [of Paradise] is the home of the veracious and the dwelling of the virtuous and righteous.
Remembrance of the Hereafter is a cure and a remedy.
May Allah have mercy on the person who takes from [his] life for [his] death, from the transitory for the everlasting and from the perishing for the permanent.
Seek the Hereafter and the world will come to you belittled.
Everything in the Hereafter is greater when seen than when heard of, so be satisfied with what you hear [of it] without seeing [it] and what you learn of [it] without witnessing [it].
How can one who is occupied with this world work for the Hereafter?
Verily you are in greater need of developing the permanent abode [of the Hereafter] than you are of building the temporary abode [of this world].
Verily you have been created for the Hereafter, not for this world, and for perpetuity, not for extinction.
Verily you have been created for perpetuity, not for extinction; and you are most certainly in a temporary abode of subsistence and a place which is not suitable for settling.
The betterment of the Hereafter is in the rejection of this world.
I am amazed at the one who knows his Lord, how can he not strive for the everlasting abode?!
One who is certain about the everlasting is uninterested in that which perishes.
One who loves the everlasting abode becomes oblivious to [worldly] pleasures.
One who hopes to attain the bountiful rewards [of the Hereafter] will not have his hopes disappointed.

Would you be happy to meet Allah tomorrow on the Day of Resurrection while He is pleased with you and not angry? Then be indifferent to [the pleasures of] this world and desirous of the Hereafter. And adopt God-wariness and honesty, for these are the consolidators of faith. And accompany the people of truth and emulate their actions - you will become one of them.
He whose goal is [attaining] this world will not be successful in [attaining] the Hereafter.

The fortunate one who becomes prosperous in the permanent abode by attaining his desires is not like the deceived one who loses the bounties [of the Hereafter] because of his bad choices and wretchedness.

Do not be one of those who hopes for the Hereafter without working [for it], and postpones repentance with long hopes; one who speaks in this world with the words of those who are indifferent [to its pleasures] but acts in it with the actions of the desirous.
None will be rewarded with the bounties of the Hereafter except those who are patient in the face of the tribulations of this world.
There is no benefit in working for the Hereafter while having desire for this world.
No one will attain an elevated rank in the Hereafter except through sincerity in action, reducing hopes and espousing God-wariness.
Become deserving of what Allah has prepared for you [in the Hereafter] by seeking the fulfillment of His true promise and being wary of the horror of His reckoning.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Brothers are the best of assets [in times of hardship].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The one who assists [you] in obeying [Allah] is the best companion.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A Friend is one whose friendship is true [even] in absence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The loss that causes illness (or burns [the heart]) is the loss of loved ones.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A companion is like a patch [of cloth], so take one that matches [yours].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: An associate is like a friend, so choose one who is suitable.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A stranger is one who does not have a [close] friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Brothers in faith have lasting affection [for each other].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The brother whom you benefit from is better than the brother [for] whom you increase [benefit].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Seeking the destruction of a friend stems from lack of conciliation.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Brothers are an embellishment in times of ease and a [means of] support in times of tribulation.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Worldly brothers are such that their affection is cut off as quickly as its causes are severed.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of your brothers is he who supports you with his benevolence, and better than him is one who makes you needless of all other than him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of brothers are the most sincere [of them] and the worst of them are the most Deceitful.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best brother is one whose brotherhood is not based on worldly gain.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best brother is one whose affection is for the sake of Allah.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best brother is one after whose loss you would not like to remain [alive].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of your brothers is one who rushes towards good and pulls you towards it, and enjoins you to righteousness and assists you in it.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of your brothers is the one who exhorts you to speak the truth by his own veracity and compels you to perform the best deeds by his own good actions.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of your brothers is the one who shows you the path of guidance, makes you acquire piety and prevents you from following your lowly desires.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of your brothers is the one who assists you financially [in your time of need].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Many a brother has not been born to your mother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The friend of an ignorant person is troubled and afflicted.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompany your brothers with kindness and cover their offences with forgiveness.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompany the intelligent and you will benefit, turn away from this world and you will be safe.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompany the intelligent, associate with the learned and overcome your vain desires, [by this] you will join the company of the Exalted Assembly.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompany the wise, associate with the forbearing and turn away from this world - you shall dwell in the Garden of the Abode.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Association with the wicked leads one to become evil, just like the wind - when it passes by a foul smell, it carries the stench.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompanying a fool is torment for the soul.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompanying a wise friend enlivens the soul.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The friend of a fool is in distress.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The friend of an ignorant person is exposed to harm.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your friend is one who forbids you [from evil] and your enemy is one who entices you [to Perform evil].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Association with the wicked leads one to have negative thoughts about the righteous.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: You should accompany the one who is intelligent and devout, for surely he is the best of companions.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: You should keep ties with brethren of purity, for they are an embellishment in times of ease and a support in [times of] tribulation.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: You should build a bond of brotherhood with the one who cautions and forbids you [from doing evil] for verily he is aiding and guiding you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who is amiable towards people is loved by them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The companionship [in this world] is short.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A friend is the closest of relations.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The friend has been named ṣadīq because he is truthful to you about your nature and faults, so have confidence in one who does this for he is your [true] friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The comrade has been named rafīq because he encourages you to improve your religion; so whoever assists you to improve your faith, then he is a concerned comrade.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: As the companionship prolongs, the [mutual] respect is affirmed.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: If you like to remain safe, then keep away from the companionship of a foolish person.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: When the sins of a friend increase, the joy of being with him decreases.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: When your friend takes you as a brother, then be like a servant to him and accord him with true loyalty and perfect sincerity.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: When the disloyalty of a friend becomes evident, forsaking him becomes easy.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Through mutual understanding, companionship lasts.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Through good companionship, camaraderie increases.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst friend is the one who is [easily] fed up.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: How bad a colleague the ignoramus is!

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: How evil a colleague the enemy is!

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: How evil a comrade the envious one is!

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Hold on to every friend who is brought close to you by hard times (and who benefits you in times of distress).

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be warm-hearted to your friend and he will be warm-hearted towards you, honour him and he will honour you, give him preference over yourself and he will give you preference over himself and his family.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A good companion is a blessing.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: An evil companion is a curse.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Sit in the company of the people of piety and wisdom and increase your discourse with them, for if you are ignorant they will enlighten you and if you are knowledgeable, you will increase your knowledge.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Good companionship increases the affection of the hearts.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The jealousy of a friend is an ailment of [his] friendship.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best choice is accompanying the righteous.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of those whom you can accompany are the people of knowledge and insight.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best person you can accompany is the one who does not compel you to seek adjudication between yourself and him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best companion is one who makes you infatuated with the Hereafter, urges you to renounce worldly pleasures and assists you in obeying your Lord.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A man’s friend is a sign of his intelligence and his speech is evidence of his merit.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of all things is that which is newer, but the best of brothers is the oldest of them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best brother is the most helpful of them in [performing] good deeds, the most active in doing good deeds and the most affable in companionship.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Many a friend may be envious.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Many a friend is scorned because of his ignorance, not because of his intention.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The beauty of companionship is tolerance.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst of your brothers is the one who makes you accept falsehood.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst of your brothers is the one who forces you to compromise and compels you to ask for pardon.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst of your friends is the one for whom you [always] have to undergo hardship.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst of brothers is one who forsakes you [in times of need].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst companion is an ignorant person.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst brother is the one who keeps ties with you in good times but abandons you in times of difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst of your brothers is the one who beguiles you with vain desire and distracts you with this world.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst of your brothers is the one who flatters you and hides your faults from you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst of your brothers is the deceiving flatterer.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst of your brothers is the one who is slow in performing good deeds and slows you down [from doing good] along with him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst and most deceitful of your brothers is the one who entices you with [the pleasures of] this transitory world and makes you unmindful of the Hereafter.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst companion is the one who changes [his loyalty] quickly.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst comrade is the one who is very suspicious.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The worst affinity is [one that leads to] putting someone into trouble.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The condition of companionship is lack of disagreement.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A bad companion is [like] a splinter of hellfire.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Companionship with the righteous leads one to acquire righteousness just like the wind - when it passes by perfume, it carries the fragrance.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Enmity with the honourable is safer than friendship with the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The companionship of a wise person is dependable.

text: Sitting with worldly people causes one to forget his faith and drives [one] towards the obedience of Satan.

text: Agreement with companions prolongs the companionship; and showing courtesy in matters makes the means [of accomplishment] easy.

text: Sitting in the company of wise men enlivens the minds and cures the souls.

text: The loneliness of a man is better for him than [having] an evil comrade.

text: By establishing ties for the sake of Allah, brotherhood becomes fruitful.

text: Brotherhood for the sake of Allah is based on advising each other for the sake of Allah, contributing for His sake, helping each other to obey His commands, forbidding each other from disobeying Him, assisting each other for His sake and sincere affection.

text: Pretend to have forgotten the bad actions of your brothers and their affection [towards you] will last longer.

text: The fruit of brotherhood is [in] protecting [the reputation of one’s brother in] his absence and presenting his faults to him [so that he may correct himself].

text: One who fraternizes for the sake of Allah, Gains.

text: One who has no brothers has no kin.

text: One who [always] argues with his brothers has few friends.

text: He who loses the one who was his brother for the sake of Allah, it is as if he has lost the most important organ of his body.

text: One who preserves [that which is entrusted to him] and is loyal will not be deprived of the benefit of brotherhood.

text: It is from weak personal judgment to break ties with one’s brothers.

text: How numerous are friends during times of prosperity and how few they are during the difficult times!

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Death of a brother is like having wings clipped and hands cut.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The order of humanity is based on righteous brotherhood and the order of religion is based on unshakable certainty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not sever ties with your brother because of some doubt that you have, and do not abandon him after he has sought [your] pardon.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not neglect the rights of your brother out of confidence in your close relationship with him, for he whose rights you neglect is not your brother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not take as a brother one who hides your positive traits and exposes your shortcomings.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not seek brotherhood [and friendship] among the uncouth people, rather seek it among the trustworthy and loyal people.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is no good in the one who abandons his brother without [him committing] any offence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is no good in the brother who does not enjoin on you what he enjoins on himself.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The brotherhood of the righteous is to be considered beneficial whereas association with the wicked and sinful is to be avoided.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to accept the words of a liar, for he will bring close to you that which is far and take far away from you that which is close.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to drive away your friend in a way that removes all the affection he has for you, and leave some room from your friendship for him so that he may rely on returning back to it.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to alienate the one who has affection for you in such a manner that he opts to distance himself and prefers to separate himself from you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to associate with the one who makes you negligent and deceives you, for he will surely forsake you and destroy you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to associate with the sinners, for verily one who is pleased with the actions of a group is like one of them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to befriend a wicked person, for he would surely sell his friendship for the most worthless of things.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is better and more appropriate to associate with people of wisdom and intelligence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best habits are honouring one’s companion and assisting one who seeks help.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The noblest of traits is guarding one’s friendship and the best of endeavours is fulfilling one’s promise.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Whoever invites you to the Eternal Abode and assists you to work for it, then he is the true, caring friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The friend in one’s worldly life is like the friend in his faith.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Inquire about the companion [on the journey] before the route.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The true friend will not turn away from his friendship even if he is treated harshly.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Bring yourself to build ties with your brother when he cuts you off, and to be kind and seek closeness [to him] when he turns away from you, and to be near to him when he distances himself from you, and to assume that he has an excuse when he does something wrong to you – to the extent that you are like his servant, and as if he has done some great favor upon you. Beware however, not to do this where it is not befitting or with someone who is not worthy of it.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be sincere in giving your brother advice whether [he finds it] courteous or offensive.

text: Bring yourself to be polite to your brother when he is harsh to you, and to build ties [with him] when he cuts you off, and to be generous [with him] when he is niggardly, and tolerate what he does and keep relations with him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Choose the new of everything but the oldest one from among your brothers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Avoid the company of a liar, but if you are forced to be in his company then do not accept his words as true, and do not let him know that you belie him, for he will readily turn away from your friendship rather than abandoning his habit [of lying].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Spare no effort in showing affection to your friend, but do not put your entire trust in him; give him all your support, but do not disclose all your secrets to him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The loss of one’s brothers weakens one’s fortitude.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: He whom you need to indulge is not your [true] brother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: He who forces his companion to argue with him is not a comrade with praiseworthy traits.

text: He who makes it necessary for you to get a judge to adjudicate between yourself and him is not your brother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The embellishment of brotherhood is good companionship and [giving] support despite [financial] difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Good brotherhood increases reward and beautifies praise.

text: The best of brothers are the least hypocritical in giving good advice.

text: The best of your brothers is the one who is stern with you regarding obedience to Allah.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of brothers is one who does not scrutinize his brothers.

text: A friend is the better of the two resources.

text: A friend is the better of the two assets.

text: A friend is a better asset and is more lasting in fondness.

text: The [true] friend is he who forbids [one from] injustice and wrongdoing while helping [one] to perform good deeds and be righteous.

text: One who takes his [relationship with his] allies lightly will find the overrunning of his enemies to be heavy.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is through brotherhood for the sake of Allah that love becomes sincere.

text: It is in times of tribulation that the protection of brethren is put to test.

text: It is when power is lost that friend is distinguished from foe.

text: In every companionship there is choice.

text: In times of difficulty one comes to know who his [true] friend is.

text: It is in times of [financial] difficulty that the value of a friend’s generosity becomes apparent.

text: Good companionship is something friends wish for.

text: Be careful not to ignore the right of your brother while relying on the bond between you and him, for he whose right you overlook is not your brother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best assets are reliable brothers.

text: The best of assets are a loyal brother and a righteous sibling.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The brother whose friendship is strongest is one who is most supportive of his brother [both] in times of ease and difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The one who journeys in search of a righteous brother journeys the farthest.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your true brother is one who forgives your mistake, fulfils your need, accepts your excuse, hides your [hidden] flaw, removes your apprehension and actualizes your hope.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not accompany one who recalls your misdeeds and forgets your virtues and merits.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The companionship of the unintelligent is not enjoyable.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: None accompany the virtuous except those who are like them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Those who sit in the company of the wicked are not safe from the calamities of tribulation.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Brothers are eliminators of grief and sorrow.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Keep yourself in the company of a virtuous and pious brother and you will remain safe, seek advice from him and you will benefit.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Love for the sake of Allah the one who struggles against you for the betterment of [your] religion and covers you with the mantle of certitude.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be courteous to your brothers and don’t expose them to the harshness of your tongue; and let your goodness flow forth for them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Offer your advice to your friend, your assistance to your acquaintance, and to all the people, your cheerfulness.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be cautious of the company of one whose opinion is accepted but whose actions are evil, for surely a person is judged by the company he keeps.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to associate with an evil colleague, for his association will destroy you and his companionship will ruin you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not give preference to an ignoble person over a noble one.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Never associate with one who has no intelligence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not associate with a fool, for he will embellish his actions for you and want you to become like him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not associate with those who love this world, for if you have less they will disregard you and if you have more they will envy you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not frequent the company of a wicked person, for if you are bestowed with a blessing, he will envy you and if a misfortune befalls you, he will abandon you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not acquire more ‘worldly’ brothers, for if you become incapable of fulfilling their wishes they turn into enemies; and their example is like the example of fire – a lot of it burns and a little of it benefits.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Take comfort for yourself in solitude rather than bad company.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be more confident of your intelligent foe than your ignorant friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Whenever the companionship prolongs, the [mutual] respect is affirmed.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: For everything there is a bane and the bane of a good person is bad company.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: For everything there is a vexation and the vexation of your lifetime is [being in] the company of an enemy.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who mingles with the wicked is not intelligent.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is nothing that brings one closer to good and keeps one safer from evil than keeping company with the righteous.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who accompanies the wise is respected.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to accompany the immoral, the wretched, and those who openly disobey the commandments of Allah.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be just as wary of sitting in the company of the ignorant, as you would be at ease in the company of the intelligent.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to remain in the company of the immoral, for surely evil clings to evil.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to be cheated by your friend or to be overcome by your foe.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to befriend a fool, for he will harm you while trying to benefit you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to befriend a miser, for he will hold back [from assisting you] when you are most in need of him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to accompany the wicked, for they consider it a favour upon you to keep you safe from themselves.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your brother is your supporter in times of difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: If you want to cut off ties with your brother [in faith] then leave some of your friendship for him, so that he may return to it someday if he so wishes.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Before choosing a friend, assess him and try hard to find out about him, otherwise you will be forced by necessity to associate with the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompanying a person [for some time] is sufficient to evaluate him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: [Even] if you have gained confidence and trust in your close friend, safeguard some of your affairs and conceal some of your secrets [from him], for it is possible that you may regret [revealing them] at some time [in the future].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: As the bond of brotherhood strengthens, compliments become distasteful.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: When you [decide to] establish the bond of brotherhood, then honour the right of brotherhood.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: If you are certain of the affection of your brother then don’t be concerned [about what transpires] when you meet him or he meets you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who takes a brother after successfully evaluating him, his companionship will last longer and his bond will be more firmly established.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who does not investigate before he takes a brother will be misled to association with the depraved.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who takes a brother without evaluation will be forced by necessity to associate with the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The amity between those who are brothers for the sake of Allah endures because of its firm foundation.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: True brotherhood is an embellishment in times of ease and a provision in times of difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The brother acquired for the sake of Allah is the nearest of relations – even closer than mothers and fathers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your brother for the sake of Allah is one who guides you towards rectitude, forbids you from corruption and assists you to improve your Hereafter.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your true friend and brother is the one who protects you with his life, and prefers you over his wealth, his children and his spouse.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is only a few of the brothers who are fair.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: An evil companion is the worst of companions; and the disease of ignobility is a concealed disease.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompany the virtuous and you will become one of them; separate yourself from the evil people and you will be dissociated from them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be sure to investigate before taking anyone as your brother, for assessment is the gauge that distinguishes the virtuous from the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who is courteous to his companion will gain his acceptance, and one who is harsh to him will drive him away and get separated from him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who is not pleased with his friend except when he prefers him over himself, will always be resentful.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One whose companionship is for the sake of Allah, his companionship is honourable and his friendship is upright.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful of the one whose friendship is not for the sake of Allah, for his friendship is wicked and his company is doomed.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who does not assist you by [his] accompanying you, then his company is [actually] a burden on you, if [only] you knew.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who does not overlook the mistakes of his friend will die lonely.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who seeks a truly loyal friend, seeks that which cannot be found.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not accompany the one who lacks determination.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One whose friendship does not benefit you, his enmity will harm you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not excuse one who is insincere in his friendship with you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One of the conditions of faith is [having] good companionship with one’s brothers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Associating with the ignorant stems from lack of intelligence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Never take your friend’s enemy as your friend, thereby making an enemy out of your friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is no life for one who is separated from those whom he loves.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is no good in a stingy (or suspicious) friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A friend is not truly a friend unless he protects his brother in his absence, his misfortune and his death.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not break off ties with a friend, even if he is ungrateful.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not trust in a friend before testing him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not count one who does not support [you] with his wealth as a friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not rely on your friend until you have tested him, and be extremely cautious of your enemy.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who keeps good ties [and company] with his brothers makes their bond [with him] last longer.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who points out your faults to you and defends you in your absence, then he is your true friend, so protect him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who has no friend has no provision.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who calls you towards the Eternal Abode and assists you to work for it, then he is indeed a caring friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One of the bad choices [that a person can make] is accompanying the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Nothing establishes the boundaries of respect like companionship and neighbourhood.

Good etiquette in a person is like a tree whose roots are the intellect.
The noblest of personal merits is good etiquette.

Good etiquette is the best trait.
Etiquette is a reflection of the intellect.
Good etiquette is the perfection of man.

The worst attribute is bad etiquette.
The fruit of good etiquette is good character.
Good etiquette covers up bad lineage.
Good etiquette is the best supporter and finest companion.
Good etiquette is the best attribute and noblest means.
The value of good etiquette is nobler than the value of lineage.
